name: EMI/EMC
description: Products subject to emissions/immunity testing or containing fast switching.
placement_rules: Filters at the entry; noisy and quiet sections separated by placement
routing_rules: Return paths under every signal; no plane crossings
copper_rules: Stitching vias around pours; continuous ground
emi_emc_rules: Hot-loop area minimised; cable shield termination plan
verification_requirements: EMC test class recorded; immunity levels are hardware tests
